message.content:
A medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
The calorie count varies with size:

| Size (approx. weight) | Calories |
|------------------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)          | 15 kcal  |
| Medium (≈123 g)        | 22 kcal  |
| Large (≈182 g)         | 33 kcal  |

These values are averages for fresh, raw tomatoes. If you’re using canned or cooked tomatoes, the calorie content will differ slightly.
